metric_definition.edge: percent of pixels with FIND_EDGES(gray) > 40 on the 256x320 resize
metric_definition.darkline: percent of pixels at native resolution more than 18 below their own GaussianBlur(2.0); thin dark strokes only

reference_sensitivity.definition: mean absolute pixel difference on the 256x320 resize; vs_plain compares each personalized image with the plain image of the same topic x seed, between_histories compares personalized images of different histories within the same topic x seed and policy
